using CUDA
using LinearAlgebra
using JSON3
CUDA.allowscalar(false)

function cuda_kernel_atom_dotprod_b_1!(i_n, loss, u, v)
    __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
    if __tid > div(i_n - 1, 1) + 1
        return nothing
    end
    i_x = 1 + (__tid - 1)
    CUDA.@atomic loss[1] += u[i_x] * v[i_x]
    return nothing
end

function cuda_kernel_atom_dotprod_b_2!(i_n, lossb, u, ub, v, vb)
    __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
    if __tid > div(1 - i_n, -1) + 1
        return nothing
    end
    i_x = i_n + (__tid - 1) * -1
    __cse_0 = lossb[1]
    ub[i_x] = ub[i_x] + v[i_x] * __cse_0
    vb[i_x] = vb[i_x] + u[i_x] * __cse_0
    return nothing
end

function dotprod_atom(loss, lossb, u, ub, v, vb, i_n)
    nthread_per_block = 256
    @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = max(1, Base.cld(div(i_n - 1, 1) + 1, nthread_per_block)) cuda_kernel_atom_dotprod_b_1!(i_n, loss, u, v)
    @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = max(1, Base.cld(div(1 - i_n, -1) + 1, nthread_per_block)) cuda_kernel_atom_dotprod_b_2!(i_n, lossb, u, ub, v, vb)
    return nothing
end

function cuda_kernel_red_dotprod_b_1!(i_n, lossb, u, ub, v, vb)
    __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
    if __tid > div(1 - i_n, -1) + 1
        return nothing
    end
    i_x = i_n + (__tid - 1) * -1
    __cse_0 = lossb[1]
    ub[i_x] = ub[i_x] + v[i_x] * __cse_0
    vb[i_x] = vb[i_x] + u[i_x] * __cse_0
    return nothing
end

function dotprod_red(loss, lossb, u, ub, v, vb, i_n)
    nthread_per_block = 256
    CUDA.@allowscalar begin
            loss[1] = loss[1] + mapreduce(init = zero(eltype(view(u, 1:i_n))), ((__mr_1, __mr_2)->__mr_1 * __mr_2), +, view(u, 1:i_n), view(v, 1:i_n))
        end
    @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = max(1, Base.cld(div(1 - i_n, -1) + 1, nthread_per_block)) cuda_kernel_red_dotprod_b_1!(i_n, lossb, u, ub, v, vb)
    return nothing
end



function bench(f, a, n)
    f(a...); CUDA.synchronize()
    t0 = time(); for _ in 1:n; f(a...); end; CUDA.synchronize()
    return (time() - t0) / n * 1e6
end

# Contention study. Not STADE output: a controlled pair that isolates how
# an atomic's cost depends on how many threads hit the SAME address.
function scatter_kernel!(out, u, nslots)
    i = (blockIdx().x - 1) * blockDim().x + threadIdx().x
    if i <= length(u)
        @inbounds CUDA.@atomic out[(i - 1) % nslots + 1] += u[i]
    end
    return nothing
end

function run_scatter(n, nslots, reps)
    u = CUDA.CuArray(rand(n)); out = CUDA.zeros(Float64, nslots)
    nt = 256; nb = cld(n, nt)
    f = () -> @cuda threads=nt blocks=nb scatter_kernel!(out, u, nslots)
    f(); CUDA.synchronize()
    t0 = time(); for _ in 1:reps; f(); end; CUDA.synchronize()
    return (time() - t0) / reps * 1e6
end

function main()
    r = Dict{String,Any}("device" => CUDA.name(CUDA.device()))

    # (a) STADE's own dotprod adjoint, both lowerings, across sizes
    red = Dict{String,Any}()
    for n in (16, 256, 4096, 65536, 1048576)
        u = CUDA.CuArray(rand(n)); v = CUDA.CuArray(rand(n))
        ub = CUDA.zeros(Float64, n); vb = CUDA.zeros(Float64, n)
        loss = CUDA.zeros(Float64, 1); lossb = CUDA.ones(Float64, 1)
        a = (loss, lossb, u, ub, v, vb, n)
        reps = n > 100000 ? 100 : 400
        ta = bench(dotprod_atom, a, reps)
        tr = bench(dotprod_red,  a, reps)
        red["n$(n)"] = Dict("atomic_us" => round(ta, digits = 2),
                            "mapreduce_us" => round(tr, digits = 2),
                            "speedup" => round(ta / tr, digits = 2))
    end
    r["dotprod_adjoint"] = red

    # (b) atomic cost against contention, at fixed work
    sc = Dict{String,Any}()
    n = 1048576
    for nslots in (1, 64, 4096, 262144, 1048576)
        sc["slots$(nslots)"] = round(run_scatter(n, nslots, 100), digits = 2)
    end
    r["scatter_1M_threads_us"] = sc
    println(JSON3.write(r))
end
main()
